scripts.check: pnpm check:code && pnpm test && pnpm security
scripts.check:code: pnpm verify:temporal-boundary && pnpm build && pnpm typecheck
scripts.check:quick: pnpm check:code && pnpm test:unit && pnpm security:audit
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @orchestra/contracts build && pnpm --filter @orchestra/temporal-codec build && pnpm --parallel --filter @orchestra/api --filter @orchestra/worker --filter @orchestra/model-worker --filter @orchestra/preview-manager --filter @orchestra/validation-worker --filter @orchestra/temporal-codec-server --filter @orchestra/web dev
scripts.security: pnpm verify:images && pnpm security:audit && pnpm security:trivy && pnpm security:prowler
scripts.security:prowler: mkdir -p .reports/prowler && docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/workspace" prowlercloud/prowler:5.37.0@sha256:c3833bcb2d4d93aedbedd772e3ec661438e7a9081d2121d60e3fbe8ff4f4100e iac --scan-path /workspace --exclude-path /workspace/node_modules /workspace/.git /workspace/.reports /workspace/apps/api/dist /workspace/apps/worker/dist /workspace/apps/model-worker/dist /workspace/apps/preview-manager/dist /workspace/apps/validation-worker/dist /workspace/apps/temporal-codec/dist /workspace/apps/web/dist /workspace/packages/contracts/dist /workspace/packages/database/dist /workspace/packages/temporal-codec/dist --severity critical high --output-directory /workspace/.reports/prowler
scripts.test: pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm test:flows
scripts.test:flows: pnpm --filter @orchestra/contracts build && pnpm --filter @orchestra/temporal-codec build && pnpm --filter @orchestra/api build && pnpm --filter @orchestra/web build && playwright test
